From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimblehealth.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API — request for technical deep-dive

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well. We're moving to the next stage in evaluating Redwood for several customer-facing features (real-time chat, multi-doc retrieval and tool calling). Would your team be available for a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive covering: SDK integration patterns, streaming best practices (client/server), function/tool calling design, and any network/security requirements we should plan for?

Proposed window: week of Dec 13 (we're flexible on exact day/time). Attendees on our side: myself (product), our engineering lead, and a security/ops contact (I can loop them in once we have a time).

Quick context: Nimble Health wants to support streaming token-by-token responses into our web client, plus server-side tool calls for third-party lookups. We're also sensitive to network egress and private VPC options.

Can you propose 2–3 slots and an agenda? If possible, include notes on what reps from Redwood would lead which sections.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Product Manager, Nimble Health
alex.turner@nimblehealth.com

- Tue Dec 14, 10:00–11:30 PT (recommended, allows 90m)

1) 10m — introductions & scope (what you want to validate)
2) 25m — SDK integration and client patterns (Grace)
3) 25m — streaming architecture and latency/cost tradeoffs (Karthik)
4) 20m — function/tool calling and security considerations (Irene)

Please see the attached agenda (host_sdk_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short network callout diagram (network_requirements.png). Marissa will be on the call to capture action items and follow-ups.

If you confirm one of the slots I'll send a calendar invite with a meeting link and pre-read links. Also let me know whether your security/ops rep should be included (we can add a short pre-read for network/VPC guidance).

Best,
